Computational fluid dynamic analysis of bioprinted self-supporting perfused tissue models

Medium AI for Bioprinting openalex Transferable Save for project in_vitro Exp. validation
T. J. Sego, Matthew Prideaux, Jane Sterner, Brian P. McCarthy, Ping Li et al. 2020-03-01 link
单位: Department of Intelligent Systems Engineering, Indiana University, Bloomington, Indiana
通讯: T. J. Sego @ Department of Intelligent Systems Engineering, Indiana University, Bloomington, Indiana
相关性: 该论文使用CFD模拟生物打印组织的灌注，但未集成AI，其方法可用于AI辅助生物打印中的数字孪生或优化。
边界: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it uses CFD simulation without machine learning or autonomous decision-making.
动机· 开发可灌注的自支撑组织模型，并利用CFD优化设计。
方法· 构建SSuPer组织并集成FABRICA灌注生物反应器，建立CFD模型分析流场。
结果· CFD模型揭示了微通道模式、流向和流速对灌注条件的影响。
验证· 通过MLO-A5成骨细胞组织灌注实验和Von Kossa染色验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop self-supporting perfused tissue constructs that mimic native vasculature and use CFD to guide design and perfusion conditions.
Method· A scaffold-free biofabrication method (SSuPer) was combined with a modular perfusion bioreactor (FABRICA), and a CFD model was built to analyze flow characteristics across five microchannel patterns.
Result· The CFD analysis identified key parameters (flow direction, fully developed flow, channel alignment) that ensure proper oxygenation and controllable shear stress.
Validation· In vitro perfusion of MLO-A5 osteoblast-based SSuPer tissue with mineral staining (Von Kossa) confirmed construct viability.

A comparative study of three biomaterials in an ovine bone defect model.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Transferable Save for project animal Exp. validation
Boyle C Cheng, Stephen Jaffee, Saadyah Averick, Isaac Swink, Steve Horvath et al. The spine journal : official journal of the North American Spine Society 2020-03-01 10.1016/j.spinee.2019.10.003
单位: Department of Neurosurgery, Allegheny Singer Research Institute, Allegheny General Hospital, Pittsburgh, PA, USA. Electronic address: boylecheng@yahoo.com.
通讯: Boyle C Cheng @ Department of Neurosurgery, Allegheny Singer Research Institute, Allegheny General Hospital, Pittsburgh, PA, USA. Electr
相关性: 该论文比较了三种生物材料（PEEK、钛涂层PEEK和3D打印PEKK）的骨整合能力，对植入物材料选择具有参考价值，但未涉及髋关节假体的应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
边界: This paper does not cover hip implant stress shielding, stiffness matching, LPBF fabrication, fatigue testing, or as-built surface morphology; it focuses on spinal interbody implants in an ovine model.
动机· 比较PEEK、钛涂层PEEK和3D打印PEKK的骨整合能力。
方法· 在羊股骨骨缺损模型中植入三种材料，8和16周后通过推出试验、组织学和影像学评价。
结果· PEKK显示出优于PEEK的骨长入和推出强度，与钛涂层PEEK相当。
验证· 体内羊动物模型，结合推出力学和组织学验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the osseointegrative capacity of PEEK, titanium-coated PEEK, and 3D-printed PEKK in an ovine bone defect model.
Method· Implants were placed in femoral epicondyles of eight sheep, and analyzed via push-out testing, histology, and radiography at 8 and 16 weeks.
Result· PEKK implants demonstrated superior bone ingrowth and push-out strength compared to PEEK, and comparable performance to Ti-coated PEEK with improved implant integrity.
Validation· The study employed an in vivo ovine animal model with ex vivo biomechanical and histological analyses.

Improvement of osseointegration by recruiting stem cells to titanium implants fabricated with 3D printing.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Peripheral Skim only animal Exp. validation
Mary Bollman, Raphael Malbrue, Chunhong Li, Hong Yao, Shengmin Guo et al. Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences 2020-03-01 10.1111/nyas.14251
单位: Department of Comparative Biomedical Sciences, School of Veterinary Medicine, Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge, Louisiana.
通讯: Shaomian Yao @ Department of Comparative Biomedical Sciences, School of Veterinary Medicine, Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge, L [推断]
相关性: 论文涉及LPBF制造的钛植入物和骨整合，但未讨论应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户关注的力学匹配方向关联较弱。
边界: This paper does not address stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization.
动机· 通过互连管状结构储存趋化因子，招募干细胞以增强骨整合。
方法· LPBF打印钛植入物，加载SDF-1α，进行干细胞招募和兔颅骨植入。
结果· 200-300μm管状植入物干细胞招募和拔出扭矩显著提高。
验证· 兔动物模型，反向扭矩测试和茜素红染色。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve osseointegration of titanium implants by designing interconnected tubular structures that act as reservoirs for chemoattractant to recruit stem cells.
Method· LPBF 3D printing was used to fabricate titanium implants with interconnected 3D tubular structures coated with SDF-1α; stem cell recruitment and in vivo rabbit skull implantation were performed.
Result· Implants with 200 and 300 µm tubular structures attracted more stem cells and required greater torque removal force, indicating enhanced osseointegration.
Validation· Animal (rabbit) model with reverse-torque test and alizarin red staining.

A comparative study of the osteogenic performance between the hierarchical micro/submicro-textured 3D-printed Ti6Al4V surface and the SLA surface.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Peripheral Skim only animal Exp. validation
Jinkai Zhang, Jiaqiang Liu, Chengtao Wang, Fengshan Chen, Xudong Wang et al. Bioactive materials 2020-03-01 10.1016/j.bioactmat.2019.12.008
单位: Department of Orthodontics, School & Hospital of Stomatology, Tongji University; Shanghai Engineering Research Center of Tooth Restoration and Regeneration, Shanghai, 200072, China.
通讯: Kaili Lin @ Department of Oral & Cranio-Maxillofacial Surgery, Shanghai Ninth People's Hospital, College of Stomatology, Shanghai Ji [推断]
相关性: 该论文涉及3D打印Ti6Al4V表面处理及骨整合性能，但未涉及力学性能、疲劳或应力遮挡，与用户研究方向的直接相关性较低。
边界: No mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no evaluation of stress shielding or stiffness matching, and no LPBF fabrication details.
动机· 改善3D打印Ti6Al4V表面的生物性能，构建层级微/亚微米结构。
方法· 对3D打印样品进行酸蚀获得亚微米凹坑，形成层级表面，并进行体外和体内评价。
结果· 3DA表面促进BMSCs增殖和骨整合，但效果不如传统SLA表面。
验证· 体外BMSCs实验和大鼠体内植入实验。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To enhance the biological performance of 3D-printed Ti6Al4V implants by constructing a hierarchical micro/submicro-textured surface.
Method· Acid etching was applied to 3D-printed Ti6Al4V to create submicron pits on the inherent micron-scale surface, and the resulting surface was evaluated in vitro and in vivo.
Result· The hierarchical surface improved BMSC adhesion, proliferation, osteogenic differentiation, and osseointegration, but its overall osteogenic performance was inferior to that of the conventional SLA surface.
Validation· In vitro BMSC assays and in vivo animal implantation studies were conducted to assess surface bioactivity and osseointegration.

Parametric uncertainty quantification in natural frequency of sandwich plates using polynomial neural network

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Skim only numerical_benchmark UQ
P. K. Karsh, Himanshu Prasad Raturi, R. R. Kumar, Sudip Dey IOP Conference Series Materials Science and Engineering 2020-03-01 10.1088/1757-899x/798/1/012036
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Parul Institute of Engineering & Technology, Parul University, Vadodara, India
通讯: P. K. Karsh @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Parul Institute of Engineering & Technology, Parul University, Vadodara, India  |  R. R. Kumar @ School of Engineering, Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi
相关性: 该论文使用多项式神经网络作为替代模型进行不确定性量化，方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的高效采样与UQ。
边界: This paper focuses on sandwich plate vibration, not implant biomechanics or contact mechanics; no biomedical context or patient-specific geometry.
动机· 高效量化夹层板固有频率的参数不确定性。
方法· 采用有限元耦合多项式神经网络替代模型，结合拉丁超立方采样。
结果· 替代模型显著降低计算成本，结果与蒙特卡洛模拟吻合。
验证· 与文献确定性结果及全蒙特卡洛模拟对比验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To efficiently quantify parametric uncertainty in natural frequencies of laminated soft core sandwich plates.
Method· A polynomial neural network surrogate model is coupled with finite element analysis, trained using Latin hypercube sampling.
Result· The surrogate model achieves significant computational savings while maintaining accuracy compared to full Monte Carlo simulation.
Validation· Validation against deterministic literature results and full-scale Monte Carlo simulation for stochastic cases.

Motivation· To minimize the number of expensive simulations or experiments required to identify design configurations meeting given specifications.
Method· A Bayesian active learning framework using entropy search and Gaussian process surrogate to adaptively select the most informative design points.
Result· The proposed approach efficiently identifies a set of valid designs with significantly fewer simulations than traditional methods.
Validation· Validation is performed on an electromagnetic structure design example, demonstrating the method's effectiveness in reducing computational cost.

动机· 优化SLM工艺参数以减少Hastelloy-X的孔隙率并改善力学性能。
方法· 改变扫描速度、激光功率、扫描间距和线能量密度，并进行不同温度和时间的热处理。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To optimize SLM process parameters for reducing porosity and improving mechanical properties of Hastelloy-X for gas turbine applications.
Method· Varied scan speed, laser power, scan spacing, and linear energy density, followed by heat treatment at different temperatures and times.
Result· Porosity decreased to ~0.5% at linear energy density >0.12 J/mm and further to 0.2% with reduced scan spacing; heat treatment caused grain coarsening and hardness reduction.
Validation· Validated by porosity measurement, microstructure observation, and hardness testing.

Iván Iraola-Real, Christina Andersson, Claudia Mego Sanchez, Ling Katterin Huaman Sarmiento 2020-03-01 10.1109/edunine48860.2020.9149485
单位: Unit of Investigation of the Faculty of Humanities Education and Social Sciences, Universidad de Ciencias y Humanidades, Lima, Perú
通讯: Iván Iraola-Real @ Unit of Investigation of the Faculty of Humanities Education and Social Sciences, Universidad de Ciencias y Humanidades,
相关性: 该论文研究数学主动学习策略，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无关。
边界: This paper is about educational methodology for mathematics, not about surrogate modeling, FEA, or any engineering simulation.
动机· 解决数学学习困难，提高工程预科生成绩。
方法· 实施学生建议的主动学习策略，进行2个月研究周期。
结果· 反思策略预测学业表现，建议、综合学习与表现负向预测数学焦虑。
验证· 122名预科生参与，t检验和回归分析验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address students' difficulties in mathematics by implementing active learning strategies suggested by students.
Method· A two-month study cycle with active learning strategies (opening, proposals, dialogue, explanation, reflection, interrogation, comprehensive learning) was conducted with 122 pre-university engineering aspirants.
Result· Reflection strategy predicted academic performance, while proposals, comprehensive learning, and performance negatively predicted math study anxiety.
Validation· Statistical analysis using Student's t-test and multiple linear regression on survey data from 122 participants.
